title: Naya FEMA Update: Export Declaration Form (EDF) for Service Exporters Effective October 2026
content:
# Naya FEMA Update: Export Declaration Form (EDF) for Service Exporters Effective October 2026

Ek important update hai for all service exporters in India! The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) ne naye Foreign Exchange Management (Export and Import of Goods and Services) Regulations, 2026 announce kiye hain, jo October 1, 2026 se lagu ho gaye hain. Is naye framework ke under, service exporters ko ab Export Declaration Form (EDF) file karna hoga for their overseas earnings.

**What's New and Who's Affected?**
*   **Previously:** Pehle, export declaration mainly goods (EDF) aur software (SOFTEX) ke liye zaroori thi. Other services ke liye koi specific declaration form nahi tha.
*   **Naya Rule:** Ab, Foreign Exchange Management (Export and Import of Goods and Services) Regulations, 2026 ke तहत, goods, software, aur *baaki sabhi services* ko ek common EDF framework ke under laya gaya hai. Iska matlab hai ki IT/ITeS services ke liye use hone wala SOFTEX form ab discontinue ho gaya hai.
*   **Scope:** Yeh niyam corporates, consulting firms, professional service providers, aur other business entities jo services export karte hain, un par lagu hota hai.
*   **Important Clarification (October 07, 2026):** Initially, there was some confusion regarding freelancers and individuals. However, RBI ne clarify kiya hai ki yeh naye reporting requirements *individuals* par lagu nahi honge. Yeh clarification freelancers, independent consultants, aur individual professionals ke liye rahat ki baat hai jo apni personal capacity mein services export kar rahe hain.

**Key Compliance Details:**
*   **Effective Date:** The new regulations came into force on October 1, 2026.
*   **Notification Reference:** Yeh rules Reserve Bank of India ke Notification No. FEMA 23(R)/2026-RB dated January 13, 2026, ke through notified kiye gaye hain. Ismein subsequent amendment Notification No. FEMA 23(R)/(1)/2026-RB dated September 22, 2026, bhi shamil hai.
*   **Filing Deadline:** Generally, EDF ko invoice raise hone wale month ke end se 30 din ke andar file karna hoga. For example, October 2026 mein raise kiye gaye invoices ke liye EDF November 30, 2026 tak file karna hoga. Non-software services ke case mein, EDF payment receive hone se pehle bhi submit kiya ja sakta hai.
*   **Consolidated Filing:** Aap ek single EDF file kar sakte hain for multiple service exports to one or more recipients during a month.
*   **Export Realisation Period:** Export proceeds ko ab invoice date se 9 months ke andar realize karke repatriate karna hoga. Agar export Indian Rupees mein invoiced ya settled hai, toh yeh period 12 months hai.

Service exporters ko apne Authorised Dealer (AD) bank se process confirm karna chahiye aur monthly EDF filing ko apne invoicing calendar mein incorporate karna chahiye.
